title: Prism: A geo-replicated data lake serving billions of <10 ms point lookups
by: Håkon Åmdal and Jeff Ling, Goldsky
summary: How Goldsky stores each blockchain’s history once in object storage and serves it in every region: recent blocks in memory, Vortex files that stay compressed in RAM, a SlateDB index beside the data on Tigris, and Tigris’s TAG cache for in-region reads. It gives real latency splits by tier (under 1 ms hot, about 9 ms through the cache, 10 to 800 ms cold) and per chain. It was reviewed by Tigris’s CEO, so read it partly as a showcase for Tigris.
